description:
python -m lunarsim.lander.trajectories                     # -> data/policies/trajectories-v1.json
    python -m lunarsim.lander.trajectories --check             # replay every exported episode and compare
frame: pad frame: pad centre at the origin, x and y horizontal, z up (altitude above the local ground plane); metres, seconds, kilograms

sampling.pos_m / vel_mps: t = 0, 0.1, 0.2, ... then t_end_s (the touchdown instant or the end of the episode); exact within each guidance step (constant acceleration)
sampling.per step k: throttle, thrust_dir, quat_wxyz, prop_kg (end of the step), alt_meas_m (the altimeter reading the pilot saw after the step), reward terms: all for the interval [0.2 (k - 1), 0.2 k]

fields.quat_wxyz: rotation taking body +z to the thrust direction (no roll)
fields.reward: per-step terms; step reward = track + effort + eta_per_step + low_alt + terminal; score = their sum over the episode (the current env's reward under the pilot's variant)
fields.matches_monte_carlo: the replay's outcome equals the Monte Carlo file's record for that seed

selection: p10 / p50 / p90: the episode whose |miss| is nearest that percentile of |miss| over the Monte Carlo episodes that reached the ground (all episodes if none did; ties to the lower seed); first_failure: the lowest seed with ok = false

CLPS.keepout_model: lunarsim/phase3.py PlumeModel: a keep-out radius R and a stand-down time T around each landing (scenario parameters, the same for every class); it has no dust-onset altitude

f33_onset_altitude_m.source: Blue Ghost M1 (SCALPSS): reaction-control plumes start acting on the surface at ~15 m: https://www.nasa.gov/general/nasa-cameras-on-blue-ghost-capture-first-of-its-kind-moon-landing-footage/

MK1.keepout_model: lunarsim/phase3.py PlumeModel: a keep-out radius R and a stand-down time T around each landing (scenario parameters, the same for every class); it has no dust-onset altitude

f33_onset_altitude_m.source: no published onset for this class; design_research.md §1.4 scales the onset with thrust (F-33 decides)
